name: shopify-erp
description: ERP multitenant para administrar varias tiendas Shopify desde un solo dashboard

scripts.dev:api: npm run contracts:build && npm run start:dev -w @erp/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run contracts:build && npm run dev -w @erp/web
scripts.build: npm run contracts:build && npm run build -w @erp/api && npm run build -w @erp/web
scripts.superadmin:create: npm run contracts:build && npm run superadmin:create -w @erp/api --
